title: UpdateManifest
description: Offline update bundle manifest (SPEC 10.1), signed with a trusted vendor Ed25519 key. Schema version 1.4.0 (1.1.0: payload kind refdata, the reference data pack of D-140; 1.2.0, D-210: release_seq, min_installed_version, key_id, not_after, the compatibility table compat.json and the optional release.json / images.lock members bound by their sha256, a key rotation, size required; 1.3.0, D-367: payload kind host, the host tree of compose files, host tools and configuration, at most one per bundle; 1.4.0, H-95: the optional pack, a software pack that names the model pack it needs by that pack's signed identity, or a model pack; no pack: a whole bundle as before).

release_seq.description: Monotonic release counter: a box refuses a bundle whose release_seq is not above the installed one (unless an audited --allow-downgrade).

min_installed_version.description: The lowest installed release_seq this bundle applies over (0: also a box never updated under D-210). Never overridable.

key_id.description: The signing key: ed25519: + the first 16 hex of the sha256 of its raw 32-byte public key. Must be a key the box trusts and must be the key the signature verifies with.

not_after.description: The bundle is refused after this time.

compat_sha256.description: sha256 of the bundle member compat.json (the compatibility table, checked before any file is touched).

release_sha256.description: sha256 of the bundle member release.json (provisional until T-110). Required when the bundle carries images.

images_lock_sha256.description: sha256 of the bundle member images.lock (the release's deploy/images.lock).

key_rotation.title: KeyRotation
key_rotation.description: A rotation bundle: signed by a trusted key, it adds one vendor key and may retire one. Accepted once.

add_public_key.description: base64 of the raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key

pack.title: Pack
pack.description: H-95: which half of a split release this bundle is. A model pack carries the engine image and the weights; a software pack carries the rest and names the model pack it needs by its bundle_id and the sha256 of its signed manifest.json. A box refuses a software pack whose model pack it does not hold.
